summary.zh: 为每个选项都痛的决策提供框架
summary.en: Framework for decisions where every option hurts

description.zh: 处理没有好答案的重大决策，比如裁员还是折价融资、是否关停投入很多的产品。从当下、十个月和十年三个时间尺度看代价，再用后悔最小化挑出更能接受的一条路。适合选项都要付出高昂代价的场合。
description.en: For decisions where no option is good, such as layoffs versus a down round or shutting down a product people love. Weighs the cost at three time scales, then uses regret minimization to make the trade-off explicit.
